hinweis_suche: Runs headless in the background (a few minutes). “+ Apify” also uses the portal scrapers — it costs Apify credits (capped by the budget); WebSearch is free.
hinweis_pruefungen: Rotating check of career pages — each run covers a selection of the target companies or headhunters, free of charge (WebFetch). Applied-jobs check: checks weekly whether the jobs you applied for are still advertised. Email check: only reads the mailbox (responses, rejections, appointments) and matches emails to your applications — without a job search.
